description:
Overview: This 3-in-1 cordless car vacuum cleaner by FUSION GADGETS is designed for quick, targeted cleaning of car interiors and other small spaces. The compact handheld design and cordless operation make it easy to carry, use and store in your vehicle or at home.

Performance & Suction: A 120W motor combined with up to 6000Pa rated suction helps lift common in-car debris such as dust, crumbs and dry dirt from seats, floor mats, dashboards and storage areas. It is intended for everyday maintenance rather than heavy industrial cleaning.

Cordless Convenience: The rechargeable lithium battery lets you clean without being limited by power cables, which is useful for parking areas, driveways and situations where sockets are not close to the car. Runtime is rated at up to about 18 minutes depending on usage and surface type.

Attachments & Reach: Multiple nozzle attachments are included to help you reach narrow gaps, corners and different surfaces inside the car. The handheld form factor makes it easier to work around pedals, between seats and along door pockets.

Filtration & Maintenance: A built-in HEPA-style filtration system is designed to trap fine particles while allowing airflow to continue. The filter section can typically be removed and cleaned as per instructions to maintain performance over time.

Usage Scope: This cordless vacuum is most suitable for cars and other compact areas where you want light, quick clean-ups. It is best used for dry debris and should be operated according to the safety and care guidelines provided with the product.
